# The Eval Index

> The Eval Index: a source-backed catalog published by Kymata Labs.

Snapshot collected: 2026-11-02T18:52:06.710473+00:00
Current catalog records: 280

## Sources and interpretation

- [Public GitHub repository searches and API signals](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/search)
- [Collection and scoring source](https://github.com/tekvisions/eval-index/blob/main/build_data.py)

Momentum blends log-scaled GitHub stars (55%), push recency decaying over 180 days (32%), and a young-repository bonus for repositories under 120 days old with at least 20 stars (13%), rounded and clamped to 1–100. Configured searches select the catalog; coverage is not exhaustive. Stars and repository activity are proxies, not measured adoption, reviews, security or product-quality benchmarks.

## Mission and scope
Kymata Labs makes open-source AI tools, models and infrastructure easier to understand through focused, source-backed indexes. We publish dated source signals, explain ranking methods and limitations, and separate advertising from ranking and inclusion.

Find the tools to measure quality, reliability and risk.

## Supported capabilities
- Browse dated catalog records and published detail pages
- Search the catalog locally in the browser; raw search text is not sent by these controls.
- Use the available catalog category filters and sorting controls
- Read source references, snapshot dates, methodology, selection guidance and evidence limits.

## Evidence limits
- Snapshot signals are not proof of quality, safety, license suitability or fitness for a project. Verify upstream sources before adoption.
- Search and filters are browser controls; this description does not advertise a remote search API or an MCP endpoint.
- Crawl permission and machine-readable descriptions do not guarantee crawling, indexing, ranking or AI citation.

- [Machine-readable capabilities, resources and dated coverage](https://eval.kymatalabs.com/capabilities.json)
- The capabilities document uses Kymata's descriptive format; it is not a standard agent tool protocol.
